snippet.title: EXODUS Extended Gameplay Reveal - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist EXODUS here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230960/EXODUS/?utm_source=future_0&utm_medium=organi[…]_content=gameplayvideo_crossdevice&utm_term=generalgaming

Archetype Entertainment shared the Extended Gameplay Reveal of EXODUS to wrap up this year's Summer Showcase. The deep dive was led by the game's director, Chris King, and dug into the sci-fi RPG's storytelling, choices, combat, companions and more. EXODUS is coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X & S in Early 2027.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #exodus
